changelog:
- Initial release of the remember-phone-calls skill.
- Enables agents to log phone call context (caller, purpose, agreements) for continuity.
- API commands provided to store and recall call history and promises.
- Integrates with BlueColumn API (API key required).
- Designed to prevent callers from repeating information and ensure smooth follow-up.
summary: Call continuity — every phone conversation leaves a trace so the next call starts with full context. Use when an agent handles inbound or outbound calls and needs to know who called, why, and what was agreed. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
